name: 이미지 계통 분석
description: Tracks the 조작 history and ancestry of images through transformation chain 분석.
algorithm: Image Phylogeny Tree Reconstruction via Pairwise Dissimilarity
mechanism: Estimates the transformation history of an image 분석하여 degradation 패턴. Each edit operation leaves cumulative traces that can be ordered into a phylogeny tree.
parameters: Dissimilarity: SSIM-based, Tree: minimum spanning, Features: 압축 아티팩트, Transform: chain
source: Dias, Z. et al. (2012) — Image Phylogeny by Minimal Spanning Trees, IEEE TIFS
useCase: 잠재적으로 조작된 이미지의 편집 이력 재구축

references.title: Dias, Z. et al. (2012) — Image Phylogeny by Minimal Spanning Trees, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• Reveals 조작 chain
• Estimates editing order
• Works with multiple transformations
• Useful for provenance tracking
limitations:
• Requires multiple image versions
• Cannot detect single-step edits
• Tree reconstruction may be ambiguous
• 계산 집약적 pairwise comparison
